title: The emails I send land in my customer's spam
description: I sent the same content twice, and both ended up in the customer's spam folder.

worklogs.description: Verified the SPF/DKIM/DMARC records via MX Toolbox, all valid.
Sent a test message via Mailtrap, the scoreboard came back clean.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hello, to resolve the issue I need you to share the recipient's mail headers. Could you ask your customer to open one of your emails in their spam folder and, by clicking 'Show original' or 'View message source', copy the full header block and send it to you?

comments.author: customer
comments.message: I asked the customer, but they're not technical — they can't find the 'Show original' menu. Would a screenshot work?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: I understand. If they're using Outlook web: open the email → top right '...' (More actions) → 'View message source'. If it's Gmail: open the email → '...' (top right) → 'Show original'. I've prepared an image with the steps, attached. Could you pass it to the customer and get back to me?

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Waiting on the header from the customer. I need to see the Authentication-Results and Received-SPF values in the header — most likely the recipient's gateway doesn't recognize our IP.
